description: This file defines an abstract Android activity class 'BaseActivity' that implements shared functionality for other activities within the 'intentplayground' project. It manages UI setup, lifecycle tracking, activity launch mechanisms, and task management features.

classes.name: BaseActivity
classes.description: An abstract class providing shared activity behavior for the intent playground app, including UI setup, launching activities, tracking, and task management.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and loads the launch mode.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Handles activity resumption, tracking, and potential forwarding of launch intents.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Performs cleanup and tracking on activity destruction.

methods.name: addTrackerListener
methods.description: Adds a listener for tracking task updates.

methods.name: removeTrackerListener
methods.description: Removes a previously added tracking listener.

methods.name: loadMode
methods.description: Initializes the UI for a specified mode (launch, verify, result).

methods.name: launchActivity
methods.description: Starts a new activity, optionally for a result.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles incoming intents, updating the activity's intent data.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the app bar menu options.

methods.name: askToLaunchTasks
methods.description: Shows a dialog to confirm launching preset tasks.

methods.name: setupTaskPreset
methods.description: Creates a predefined task and activity structure for testing.

methods.name: runIntentTests
methods.description: Attempts to launch test activities for purpose of validation.

methods.name: prepareLaunchForward
methods.description: Prepares and returns an intent to forward to another activity if specified.

methods.name: onUserLeaveHint
methods.description: Tracks when the user leaves the activity to facilitate testing.
